title: Company Objective Constellation — initiative stitching, drift detection, and escalation lanes
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Company-level objectives and downstream initiatives are drifting between planning cycles. Engineers and PMs report unclear ownership, duplicated effort across teams, and late discovery of priority changes. Goals: 1) Create an "Objective Constellation" — a single reconciled mapping from company objectives -> priority themes -> active initiatives across orgs. 2) Instrument drift detection so we detect when initiative scope, resourcing, or KPIs diverge from the objective thread. 3) Define clear escalation lanes and capacity signaling so trade-offs are decided before commitments slip. Scope: discovery with stakeholders, prototype mapping format (spreadsheet + canonical fields), lightweight drift rules and alerts, a dashboard for exec/PM review, and a repeatable quarterly playbook for interlock and sign-off. Out of scope: full automation of initiative planning or replacing existing OKR tools during this cycle.
deliverables: Drift detection rule set and sample alerts (PagerDuty/Slack wiring guidance)
Escalation runbook with RACI and SLA windows
Alignment dashboard (Grafana/Metabase) with drilldown to initiative cards
Quarterly roll-out playbook and stakeholder sign-off checklist
acceptance_criteria: Mapping covers >=95% of active company-level objectives and all funded initiatives for the quarter
Dashboard surfaces a clear ownership column and one-click drilldown to initiative artifacts (PRD/roadmap)
Drift detection triggers on: >15% variance in target metric, scope change >2 major features, or >20% resourcing change, with automated Slack alert to owners
Escalation runbook approved by GTM, Eng, and Finance with defined SLA windows and decision authority
Pilot run executed for two cross-functional initiatives and feedback incorporated into playbook
risks: Teams treat mapping as another doc and don't keep it updated (mitigate via lightweight required weekly check-in),
False positives from naive drift rules create alert fatigue (mitigate via tuned thresholds and manual review window),
Capacity signaling requires Finance / SRE buy-in; delays could block rollout
success_metrics: Time-to-detect objective drift reduced from avg 28 days to <7 days
% of initiatives with explicit objective-mapping increases from 62% to >=95%
Number of emergency re-prioritization meetings (after planning) drops by 50% over next quarter
Stakeholder satisfaction (post-pilot survey) >=80% net promoter among PM/Eng leads
